title: Pattern Programming
goal: Nested loops se star, number, alphabet, pyramid, diamond aur hollow patterns banana.
definition: Pattern program nested loops se rows aur columns ki shape banata hai: outer loop rows, inner loop columns/spaces.
explain: Har pattern do sawaalon se banta hai: kitni rows? aur har row me kitne spaces + kitne characters?
Pyramid me spaces ghatte hain aur stars badhte hain: row i par (n-i) spaces aur (2i-1) stars.
Dry run table banao: row, spaces, stars, output line. Isse off-by-one turant pakda jaata hai.
Hollow patterns me sirf border par character aata hai: first/last row ya first/last column.
analogy: Pattern ek grid hai jisme aap decide karte ho kaunsa cell bharna hai aur kaunsa khali chhodna hai — nested loop wahi row/column ka pointer hai.
why: Patterns loops, conditions aur dry-run ka best exercise hain aur interview me logic build karne ka classic sawaal hain.

syntax.note: Outer = rows, inner = columns; newline outer loop ke andar.

topics.title: Star patterns
topics.body: Right triangle: j <= i. Inverted: j <= n-i+1. Square: n x n. Hollow square: border condition i==1||i==n||j==1||j==n.

topics.title: Number aur alphabet patterns
topics.body: Increasing numbers: print j. Floyd triangle: running counter. Alphabet: 'A' + (j-1) ya row-wise increment.

topics.title: Pyramid aur diamond
topics.body: Pyramid: spaces n-i, stars 2i-1. Diamond = pyramid + inverted pyramid, beech ki row ek baar. Hollow pyramid: sirf first/last star aur base.

examples.title: Right triangle
lines: Inner loop i stars print karta hai.

examples.title: Pyramid aur diamond
lines: Har row me n-i spaces phir 2i-1 stars.
Diamond ke liye ulta loop n-1 se 1 tak.
Beech ki sabse badi row ek hi baar print hoti hai.

mistakes.why: Har star ke baad newline se vertical line ban jaati hai.
Ek extra space se pyramid right shift ho jaata hai.

mistakes.wrong: Diamond me middle row do baar
mistakes.why: Beech ki row duplicate dikhti hai.

debug.brief: Inverted triangle ki jagah seedha aa raha hai. Fix karo.
hints: Stars har row me kam hone chahiye.
debug.fix: for (int j = 1; j <= n - i + 1; j++) printf("*");

best: Pehle paper par row plan likho
Har row ke spaces/stars ka formula nikalo
Hollow patterns me border condition alag rakho

practice.title: Square
practice.prompt: n x n stars ka square print karo.
practice.hint: Outer aur inner dono n tak.

practice.title: Floyd triangle
practice.prompt: 1 se badhta counter triangular shape me print karo.

practice.title: Hollow square
practice.prompt: Sirf border wala square print karo.

mcqs.q: Pyramid row i me stars kitne?
Pattern me outer loop kya control karta hai?
mcqs.explain: Outer loop rows, inner loop row ke andar ka content.

interview.q: Pattern program ka logic kaise todte ho?
interview.a: Row count nikalo, har row ke liye spaces aur characters ka formula likho, phir nested loops me wahi formula daalo. Dry run se verify karo.
interview.followUp: Hollow pattern ka trick? — border condition.

interview.q: Patterns ka real use kya hai (sirf interview)?
interview.a: Nested loop aur coordinate thinking sikhate hain jo matrices, image processing aur canvas rendering me same tarah use hoti hai.

lab.title: Lab 8 — Pattern set
lab.brief: n input lo aur right triangle + inverted triangle dono print karo.

checkpoint.title: Module 8 checkpoint
checks: Pyramid ka spaces/stars formula aata hai
